summary: Re-measured on 49b9f109. Every required gate passes: typecheck, strict content:check (0 warnings), probe 48/48, build, e2e flow, perf_1080 --prod (GATE PASS), value_probe (0 FAIL), icon_probe, the audio contract gates, 8 node audio probes, probe_audio_world, bot soak quick, the secret scan and sweep_720. The gate still fails on one major item. The gate engineer said e2e rift and store pass; on my run both fail (exit 1). Two causes combine. In the e2e harness, match_input pressed P before the HUD took input: the shop did not open (shopOpen false, shopTags [], scoreboard false), so the step's Escape opened the in-match Menu. Because the step does not assert shopOpen, it passed anyway and the F8 genre-word check passed with no tags to check. The second cause is in the client: the in-match Menu (src/ui/screens/match.tsx:45-56) is opened through overlay.open and never closed when the match ends. It stayed open through the whole match and over the VICTORY post-game, where its Resume / Settings / Leave match buttons blocked the Lantern-nod click. The STORE journey then could not reach the Shop. This code has not changed since 2026-10-13, so the bug is old, not a regression from this run; the race only exposed it. Smaller notes: the match peak is 484k triangles, not the claimed 479k, which is 3.2 % under the 500k budget; programs are exactly at the 40 cap; Ultra reads 40.7 fps (ungated). The claims I spot-checked (lod.ts uvW, profile_store emblem, items vfx, the ranked-ban docs, the dev-catalog Lamplit glb, the cited commits) all hold.

node _harness/e2e.mjs rift --out _harness/_reports/integ_gate_e2e_rift.json: 'FAIL (rift:FAIL store:FAIL)', exit 1, 177 s.
- home through match_end pass; the match reaches a real Victory at 25:33.
- postgame fails: 'locator.click: Timeout 15000ms exceeded' on .pgnod__mate. The click hits h2.modal__title of the in-match 'Menu' modal (Resume / Settings / Leave match), which is still open over the VICTORY screen (_harness/_shots/integ_gate_e2e_rift_10_postgame_FAIL.png).
- store then fails: the 'Shop' nav item never shows (integ_gate_e2e_store_01_shop_FAIL.png).
- Cause 1, the harness: match_input reported {shopOpen:false, shopTags:[], scoreboard:false}. P did not reach the HUD, so _harness/e2e.mjs:178 pressed Escape and opened the Menu (shown open at game 0:21 in integ_gate_e2e_rift_07_match_input.png). The step does not assert shopOpen, so it passed, and the F8 genre-word check passed with no tags to check.
- Cause 2, the client: the Menu stays open from 0:21 to the end of the match and across the route change (see client:stale-match-menu).
- Every earlier e2e run had shopOpen true, including integ_lead_final_e2e_rift.log, so this is a race that does not hit every run. Even so, the gate engineer's 'e2e rift / store PASS' did not reproduce here.
- Budget: 3 perf/e2e runs were used (flow, perf, rift), so I could not re-run.
items.fixHint:
Two small changes, then re-run `node _harness/e2e.mjs rift`.
(a) client, src/ui/screens/match.tsx: keep the id returned by overlay.open for the Menu (and for the Leave-match confirmDialog). Close them when MatchScreen unmounts (a useEffect cleanup) or when state.ending turns true, so no in-match dialog reaches the post-game.
(b) harness, _harness/e2e.mjs match_input (:171-182): before pressing P, wait for the HUD to take input (.hud .dbar visible and overlay.modals empty). Throw when shopOpen is false, so the F8 tag check cannot pass with no tags, and press Escape only while the shop is open.

notes: The e2e rift/store failure is not a code regression from this run. src/ui/screens/match.tsx is unchanged since 2026-10-13. The P-then-Escape press in match_input (_harness/e2e.mjs:173/:178) dates from 2026-10-13/14. What 768febb5 (2026-10-29, client F15) added is the Lantern-nod click on the post-game. Before it, the postgame step only read state, so a leftover Menu could not fail the journey. Now any run where P misses the HUD fails, and this run is the first one where that happened.
